test_title: PYST 54: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db3fdc66e1d95c51f9f5d4d635a77c334528e216bb62c5c000db932b023d91ca.png] 

**Given letter-cluster pairs:**

CI - EL

IO - KQ

JP - LR

NT - PV

**Observe the pattern:**

In most pairs, each letter of the second cluster is obtained by adding +2 to the corresponding letter of the first cluster.

**Check each option:**

Option 2: IO - KQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a7ac092fc520bc3e6b2e083695c85243676870bc7f50fd8cee2f890e2f08dce.png] 

Option 3: JP - LR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/555b5fecc5f61cbf370bc70f3f454f1311625af36adbcb2256047857b524de6d.png] 

Option 4: NT - PV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07ed2768476a1141454928708980206c3d22d98a1572ac73b0de05175a95fd9f.png] 

**Option 1: CI - EL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a478cdba6187282c62cd60e19cf98ba41eb7158010476f599c39bdd422060235.png] 

Thus, **CI - EL** does not follow the common pattern.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".**
